Method of Attack: Spyware and premium dialer that accesses notifications, reads and sends SMS texts to invisibly subscribe victims to premium services; Uses XOR encryption with a static key to conceal malicious functionality; Downloads initial payload from command and control (C2) server; Filters out devices from U.S. and Canada by reading operator information; Extracts premium service confirmation code (2FA) from incoming SMS and sends it to offer page; Opens URLs for premium services in hidden webview
Attack Vector: Malicious apps uploaded to Google Play Store disguised as camera, wallpaper, SMS, and photo editing software
Indicators of Compromise: Hidden webview opening premium service URLs
Apps with package names: com.app.reyflow.phote, com.race.mely.wpaper, com.landscape.camera.plus, com.vailsmsplus
